DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのテーブルをご利用予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you planning to use this table?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。誰もいないので座ろうと思いましたが、この札は予約ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空いて見える席を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. No one is here, so I was going to sit down. Does this sign mean it is reserved?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may use a seat that looks unoccupied. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その区画は、これから団体が利用する予約席です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That section is reserved for a group that will be using it shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は空いていても、一般の休憩席ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約札の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even though it is empty now, it is not a general rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check what the reservation sign means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。一般のベンチは、向こうの木陰にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. The public benches are over there in the shade of the trees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で少し休みたいです。二人が座れる所を見てきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一般利用の席を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two of us, and we would like a short rest. I will look for somewhere we can both sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about seating available to the public. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空いている席を、他の方と譲り合ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please share any available seats considerately with other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約席の椅子を持って行かず、向こうの一般席を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行人数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not take chairs from the reserved area; we will use the public seating over there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say how many people are with you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。一般席には予約札はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Public seating does not have reservation signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木陰の席を確認し、空きがあれば二人で休みます。このテーブルは使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一般席で譲り合って休むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the seats in the shade, and if there is space, we will both rest there. We will not use this table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the public seating considerately while resting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一般のベンチはこちらの道の先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. The public benches are farther along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の遅れで、ほかの経路をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for another route because the train is delayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駅前にバスがあります。この切符で乗れる代わりの輸送でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車の遅れで別経路を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a bus outside the station. Is it replacement transport that I can use with this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for another route because of the train delay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あれは通常の路線バスです。列車の切符で乗れるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is a regular scheduled bus. Your train ticket does not necessarily let you ride it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前に来ているから、代替のバスと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: バスを使う条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed it was a replacement bus because it was outside the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for using the bus. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代替手段については、駅の正式な案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the station's official announcements about alternative transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まずその案内を聞きたいです。通常のバスを使うなら、目的駅まで行くかと料金も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通常路線と代替輸送を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to hear that information first. If I use the regular bus, I will also check whether it goes to my destination station and what the fare is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish regular bus services from replacement transport. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅の担当者をご案内します。バスの路線と運賃はバス側の案内でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will direct you to the station staff. Please also check the bus operator's information for the route and fare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。切符があるから無料だと決めず、二つの案内を分けて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目的地と料金を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not assume it is free because I have a ticket; I will ask separately about the two kinds of information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you would like to check the destination and fare. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明を受けてから、利用する経路をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose your route after you have received the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はバスへ飛び乗らず、代替の有無と通常バスの条件を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明を受けてから経路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not jump on the bus now. I will ask whether replacement transport is available and about the regular bus conditions before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose your route after receiving the explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。運行案内の担当はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. The staff member handling service information is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の予約をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to book a consultation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、来週の水曜に予約済みです。その日に行けなくなったので、別の日に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既存の予約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but I already have a booking for next Wednesday. I can no longer attend that day, so I would like to change it to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your existing booking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新規の追加ではなく、現在の予約の変更ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is a change to your current booking, rather than an additional new booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。二つの枠を残すつもりはありません。この控えに予約番号があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加できなくなった理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Exactly. I do not intend to keep two slots. The booking number is on this confirmation slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you can no longer attend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の予約を確認します。金曜の午後が候補です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the original booking. Friday afternoon is one option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜午後なら参加できます。水曜の枠も取り消してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更として扱いたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can attend on Friday afternoon. Could you also cancel the Wednesday slot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for this to be treated as a booking change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更の手続きで、元の枠の扱いも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: As part of the change procedure, I will check how the original slot is handled too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。金曜だけ取って、水曜がそのまま残らないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の予約を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I want to book only Friday and make sure Wednesday does not remain booked as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the original booking details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。水曜は取り消し、金曜午後三時で登録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have confirmed it. We will cancel Wednesday and register Friday at 3 p.m.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水曜は取り消し、金曜三時が現在の予約ですね。予定を一つに直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧の予約状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So Wednesday is canceled and my current booking is Friday at three. I will update my schedule to just one appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the status of the old and new bookings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。変更後の控えをお渡しします。金曜午後三時にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Here is the updated confirmation. Please come at 3 p.m. on Friday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 領収書についてご不明な点がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something unclear about your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三千円とありますが、私は五千円札を渡しました。金額が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書の金額について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 3,000 yen, but I handed over a 5,000-yen note. Is the amount wrong?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the amount on the receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お釣りの二千円は受け取られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you receive the 2,000 yen in change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、封筒に入っています。五千円から二千円が戻ったので、支払いは三千円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口へ渡した金額を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is in the envelope. I got 2,000 yen back from 5,000 yen, so I paid 3,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how much you handed to the counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 領収書には、お支払いになった三千円が記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The receipt records the 3,000 yen you paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 渡した紙幣の額を、そのまま領収書の額だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お釣りを受け取ったことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the receipt amount would be the full value of the banknote I handed over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you received the change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 預かり額と、お釣りと、支払額を分けてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish the amount tendered, the change, and the amount paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お釣り二千円があります。領収書の三千円と合わせて五千円になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の支払額を計算する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have 2,000 yen in change. Together with the 3,000 yen on the receipt, that makes 5,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Calculate the amount actually paid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。そのお会計で完了しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. That transaction has been completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一致を確認できました。領収書は三千円の支払記録として保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書の記録と一致を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed that the amounts match. I will keep the receipt as a record of paying 3,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the figures match the receipt record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。領収書とお釣りをそろえて、お持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take both your receipt and your change with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物は何でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青いカバーの手帳です。実はカバーの内側に、小さい白い連絡帳も挟んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手帳の紛失を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A planner with a blue cover. Actually, I also had a small white communication notebook tucked inside the cover.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost a planner. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二冊を別々の場所でなくされたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you lose the two books in separate places?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。一つのカバーに二冊入れていました。最後に見た時も一緒でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カバー内の別冊を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I had both books in one cover. They were together the last time I saw them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add that there was another notebook inside the cover. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外からは、青い手帳一つに見えるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So from outside it looks like one blue planner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。白い連絡帳は中にあります。別々の紛失品として二か所を探すのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一つのまとまりだったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The white communication notebook is inside. We are not looking in two places for separately lost items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that they were together as one item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外側と内側の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me the features of the outside and the inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青いカバーには丸いシール、白い連絡帳の表紙には私の名前があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外見と内部の目印を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a round sticker on the blue cover, and my name is on the cover of the white communication notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the external and internal identifying marks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell me where you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅前の喫茶店の机です。一つのカバーに手帳と連絡帳の二冊が入った状態として届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二冊入りの状態で記録してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: On a table in the café outside the station. I would like to report it as one cover containing two books, the planner and communication notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have it recorded as containing two books. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まとまった一つの品物として、外側と内部の特徴を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record it as one combined item, with the external and internal features listed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a missed-delivery notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。金曜までとありますが、私は予定表に月曜受取と書きました。延長したことになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の予定表への記入で保管延長になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says until Friday, but I wrote “collect Monday” in my calendar. Does that mean the storage period has been extended?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether entering it in your own calendar extends the storage period. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の予定表への記入と、担当への申込みは別ですね。何か連絡はされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Writing it in your own calendar and applying to the staff are separate matters. Have you contacted anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。書くだけで三日延びたと思っていました。月曜は私の希望で、受付された日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当へ未連絡で月曜は受付済みでなく希望だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought just writing it down extended it by three days. Monday is my preference, not an accepted collection date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself, saying you have not contacted the staff and Monday is a request rather than an accepted date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の期限と荷物の状況を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the current deadline and the parcel's status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ金曜の前なので、今できる受取方法を相談したいです。延長できることを前提にせず聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限前に相談し延長前提にせず受取方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is still before Friday, so I would like to discuss the collection methods currently available. I will ask without assuming an extension is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consult before the deadline and ask about collection without assuming an extension. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在票の番号をお見せください。ご在宅になれる日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show me the notice number. Is there a day you can be at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木曜の夜なら家にいます。ただ、再配達の申込みもまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在宅候補日を伝え再配達も未申込だと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be home on Thursday evening. However, I have not applied for redelivery yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give a possible day at home and clearly say you have not requested redelivery. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望枠の可否と手順を確認します。案内前に、木曜へ変更済みとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check availability for your requested slot and the procedure. Until you receive guidance, do not assume it has already been changed to Thursday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予定表の月曜は未確定と直します。案内された方法で申込み、受付結果を見てから受取予定を確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確定の予定を訂正し申込後の受付結果で受取予定を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will mark Monday in my calendar as unconfirmed. I will apply using the method explained and finalize my collection plan after checking the acceptance result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the unconfirmed plan and decide the collection schedule based on the result after applying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の保管期限と、ご希望の木曜の受取について担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the current storage deadline and your preferred Thursday collection with the staff responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失ですね。口座名義のお客様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have lost a card, correct? Are you the account holder?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、なくなったのは家族が使う代理人用のカードです。私の本人カードはあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失対象が代理人用だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. However, the missing card is an authorized representative's card used by a family member. I still have my own account-holder card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the lost item is the representative's card. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ口座に、二種類のカードがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So there are two kinds of card for the same account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。口座番号だけ伝えると、本人カードもないと思われそうなので、分けて説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人カードは手元にあると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Exactly. If I give only the account number, you might think my own card is missing too, so I would like to explain them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you have your own card with you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象カードと停止の範囲を、担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will check which card is involved and the scope of the suspension.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。本人カードはこちらで、代理人用については家族からなくしたと連絡がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ口座の別カードだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. My own card is here, and my family member contacted me to say the representative's card was lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a different card for the same account. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 家族の方から確認できた日時なども伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also ask about dates and times confirmed with your family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝ないと気付いたそうです。最後の使用は、家族にもう一度確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象を特定して停止範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said they noticed it missing this morning. I will ask them again about when it was last used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the relevant card and check the scope of suspension. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の確認後、対象を特定してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After verifying your identity, we will identify the card and explain the next steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず本人確認をお願いします。代理人用の紛失として、止める対象と結果を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当確認後の結果を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please verify my identity first. As this is the loss of the representative's card, I want to confirm which card will be blocked and the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the result after the staff's checks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人カードが手元にあることも記録し、代理人用の対象を確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will also record that your own card is with you, identify the representative's card involved, and proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品回収の案内についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the product recall announcement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ名前の商品を家に持っていたので、持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内を見て持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I had a product with the same name at home, so I brought it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought it after seeing the announcement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には、対象の製造番号も書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The announcement also lists the manufacturing numbers affected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品名が同じ物は全部対象かと思いました。番号はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ商品名だけで判断していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought everything with the same product name was affected. Where is the number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you judged it by the product name alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容器の底にあります。担当者が案内の番号と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is on the bottom of the container. The staff will compare it with the number in the announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 底の数字はこちらです。自分で読み違えないよう、確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 製造番号の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are the numbers on the bottom. Please check them so I do not misread them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the manufacturing number is located. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品と案内を一緒に拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look at the product and announcement together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。名前だけで対象とも対象外とも決めず、番号の結果を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象番号との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I do not want to decide it is included or excluded based only on the name; I would like to hear the number-check result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for comparison with the affected numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後、対象の場合の対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will explain what to do if it is affected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その結果に従います。まだ捨てず、この容器のままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果に従って対応すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow that result. I will not throw it away yet; I will hand it over in this container as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will act according to the verification result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。製造番号を照合し、対象かどうかと次の対応をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will compare the manufacturing number and explain whether it is affected and what to do next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か園内で気になることがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something in the park that concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 北の園路に大きな枝が落ちていて、道の幅いっぱいに広がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枝が落ちた場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A large branch has fallen on the north park path and spreads across the full width of the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where the branch fell. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所の目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there a landmark for the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池へ向かう坂の手前、三番の案内板の横です。通ろうとする人が引き返していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通行できない幅を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside information board number three, before the slope toward the pond. People trying to pass were turning back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it blocks the width of the path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枝は動かされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。重そうなので触らずに来ました。係の方に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で移動していないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. It looked heavy, so I came here without touching it. I would like a staff member to look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply that you did not move it yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認の担当へ伝えます。お客様は別の道をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will inform the staff responsible for checking. Please use another path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場へ行くには、どの道で回れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 係員の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Which path can I take around to get to the plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask a staff member to check it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 南側の園路から回れます。三番の案内板の方へは進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can go around using the southern path. Please do not proceed toward information board number three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南側へ回ります。枝を自分でどかさず、確認をお願いしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 迂回路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go around to the south. I will not move the branch myself, and will leave the inspection to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the detour. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。三番の案内板の横として担当へ連絡します。南側の道をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will tell the staff it is beside information board number three. Please use the southern path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この企画券をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in this special ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 気になっています。ただ、行きたいのは対象の終点より一駅先です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最終目的地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but my destination is one station beyond the end of its eligible section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your final destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象区間は、こちらの色が付いた範囲です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The eligible section is this shaded area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目的地は色の外ですね。一駅分を追加する方法があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 企画券の対象区間を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My destination is outside the shading. I would like to know if there is a way to add the extra station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the special ticket's eligible section. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 区間外の扱いと、追加の料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check how travel outside the section is handled and the additional fare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。企画券の価格だけではなく、目的地まで全部でいくらか比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 区間外の一駅の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to compare the total cost all the way to my destination, rather than just the special ticket's price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how the one station outside the section is handled. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通常の券で全区間を買う方法もあわせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also explain the option of buying a regular ticket for the entire journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その二つを比べて選びます。企画券だけで最後まで行けるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全区間の料金を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare those two and choose. I will make sure not to assume the special ticket alone takes me all the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the fares for the entire journey. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件と合計が確認できましたらご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain once the conditions and totals have been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最終目的地はこちらです。その駅まで使える方法と合計を聞いてから購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した条件で券を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is my final destination. I will buy a ticket after hearing the method valid to that station and the total cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a ticket based on the confirmed conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。目的地までの利用条件を確認して、二つの方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the travel conditions to your destination and explain the two options.
